sloka: ततः समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य रक्षोगणा वानरयूथपानाम्।अमृष्यमाणाः परहर्षमुग्रं महाबला भीमतरं विनेदुः ।। ६.६९.४५ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ samudghuṣṭaravaṁ niśamya rakṣogaṇā vānarayūthapānām।amṛṣyamāṇāḥ paraharṣamugraṁ mahābalā bhīmataraṁ vineduḥ ।। 6.69.45 ।।

translations.english: Those monkey leaders entering dreadful Rakshasa army uplifted rocks and mountains with trees and shone.
